data_notes: hold_reason is WRONG. This is a real, long-operating, heavily-reviewed restaurant (Yelp shows 1260+ reviews as of Sept 2026, established 1988), not a permit-only record with no public presence. It has an active website (mamas-bakery.com), Facebook, Tripadvisor, and multiple delivery-app listings (ezCater, Grubhub, Uber Eats, Postmates, Ritual). It should be un-held and listed. Two data caveats: (1) the restaurant relocated in mid-2025 from 4237 Alabama St to 2141 El Cajon Blvd (still North Park, 'One Mississippi' building) - our stored address is the old, pre-relocation location and lat/lng likely need updating to the new site; the DEH permit id (DEH2004-FFPP-411701) corresponds to the old Alabama St address. (2) Neighborhood label 'University Heights' is wrong even for the old address - 4237 Alabama St and the new 2141 El Cajon Blvd address are both North Park, per local press (San Diego Magazine, WhatNow). Cuisine should be Mediterranean/Lebanese (currently null).
